python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

arr = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png').convert('RGB'))
# Let's inspect objects by color ranges or find components
# 1. Floor lamp: yellow cone top, grey pole, grey circular base
# 2. Plant 1 (near): brown/terracotta pot, green stem/leaves
# 3. Plant 2 (far right): terracotta pot, green stem/leaves
# 4. Table: brown top and legs
# 5. Couch / armchair: blue-grey
# 6. White/light grey box or cabinet on left foreground

# Let's find pixels for green (leaves):
green_mask = (arr[:, :, 1] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 80) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 80)
print('Green pixels:', np.sum(green_mask))

# Terracotta pots:
pot_mask = (arr[:, :, 0] > 140) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 60) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 120) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 70)
print('Pot pixels:', np.sum(pot_mask))

# Lamp shade: yellow
lamp_shade = (arr[:, :, 0] > 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 160) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 150)
print('Lamp shade pixels:', np.sum(lamp_shade))

# Grey couch:
couch_mask = (arr[:, :, 2] > arr[:, :, 0] + 5) & (arr[:, :, 0] > 80) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 140)
print('Couch pixels:', np.sum(couch_mask))

# Table:
table_mask = (arr[:, :, 0] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 40) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 90) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 50)
print('Table pixels:', np.sum(table_mask))

# White cabinet/cube:
cube_mask = (arr[:, :, 0] > 180) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 240) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 240) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 180) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 240) & (arr[:, :, 0] == arr[:, :, 1])
print('Cube pixels:', np.sum(cube_mask))
"
